rules.title: Seven real combat participants
rules.requirement: Every one of guardian_dog, gray_wolf, fox, owl, male_lion, white_tiger and brown_bear retains an unlocked, usable species-specific attack. Scouting, warning, retrieval, hauling and other specialties are additional value; they cannot replace attack or turn fox/owl into support-only pets.

rules.title: Useful attack outcome
rules.requirement: Every species has at least one ordinary eligible-hostile scenario in which a valid attack inflicts real positive damage and helps the player. Cosmetic swipes, an unused animation, a statistics-only aura, a warning marker or merely being marked attack_allowed do not pass. Exact damage and cadence require balanced actor/target evidence.

rules.title: Complete attack state and contact
rules.requirement: Bind ready/approach/anticipation/commit/contact-or-miss/recovery/return, interruption and resume to the actual species rig. Each intentional contact group has an authoritative attack-instance/event identity; repeat overlap, extra claws, animation callbacks or reload cannot duplicate that group. An intentionally multi-hit attack must declare its separate groups. A miss, invalid target or cancellation before contact causes no damage.

rules.title: Legitimate targets and friendly identity
rules.requirement: Friendly pets and survivors attack only living eligible hostile or explicitly authorized hunt targets, validated by stable instance identity, faction/role, state and environment. The huntable flag belongs to a target instance; a wolf mesh or meat render is not permission to attack an owned wolf. Friendly pets, workers, customers and rescue actors are not player-team prey or reward sources. Enemy target selection is a different U3 policy: a provoked survivor can be targeted by that enemy; when both player and eligible defending pets are far, all exposed characters including visitors may be targeted. Real collateral contact is not negated by target preference. Defeat rewards remain exactly once and never derive from friendly deaths.

rules.title: Stable and readable priorities
rules.requirement: Keep the simple goal/recall/optional-priority interface and T07 frozen human-context ownership. Survivors can perform authorized hunts and attacks, alongside all ordinary work; do not restore the withdrawn self-defense-only limitation. Pet/job arbitration favors an explicit recall or escape, an immediate threat to the assigned ally/area, a selected reachable target, assigned defense/hunt, then useful work or safe opportunistic action. A validated directed attack attempt, including a miss, records provocation for that enemy and survivor instance only. Keep a valid target stable until priority or eligibility changes. A nearby living camp-assigned defending pet counts; dead, undeployed, nondefending or fleeing pets do not. Near-defender enemy selection cannot fall back to an unprovoked survivor if every higher target is unreachable.

rules.title: Physical range, pursuit and return
rules.requirement: Bind sight/reach/occlusion, pursuit, real disengagement and return to actual profiles and geometry. Camp coordinates grant no permanent immunity. Intact fences/gates block appropriate attacks; open or breached approaches change reachability and collision. Boundary HP is high but finite; equipment remains damageable. A camp threat persists when the player travels away; distance-based rendering cannot despawn it or restore HP. Defense-range entry/exit hysteresis is saved. Provocation expires only after real disengagement, not a gate crossing, reload or leash-reset shortcut. No invisible damage, clipping, omniscient chase or walking through intact barriers.

rules.title: Recall, preemption and useful resumption
rules.requirement: Recall prevents acquiring/extending pursuit; precontact cancellation causes no hit and committed contact is never duplicated. Attack/work/escape transitions revalidate live instance, health, target, cargo, reservations, destination and ordinary budget. Death immediately cancels attacks and releases transient job claims; accepted plot contributions remain in their quote escrow. A surviving actor may resume/reassign a valid job. A tombstoned actor never resumes through reload, roster switching or a new assignment.

rules.title: Cargo and tools remain truthful
rules.requirement: Use compatible tool/cargo transitions before attacking: mouth/talon cargo must be secured, handed off or explicitly set down before an incompatible bite/strike. Unlimited logical survivor cargo is independent of rendered stacks. Companion death and equipment/counter/storage destruction move remaining player-owned contents once into persistent typed salvage; no wipe, duplicate carried copy or automatic clone on replacement. Already consumed recipes/repair effort are not refunded; sold customer goods are customer-owned and cannot become resale loot. Transfer/payment/quote ownership is atomic at the authoritative commit.

rules.title: Coordinated attacks and fair rewards
rules.requirement: Share bounded engagement-space and target reservations across player, pets, survivors and destructible defenses. Concurrent contacts and overkill cannot multiply HP loss, defeat rewards or salvage. Attack contacts carry stable attacker/target instance and generation, attack/contact-group IDs. A retired siege gives no victory/clear reward. All seven pet species remain true combat contributors; a dead body or roster entry contributes neither defense-range coverage nor attacks.

rules.title: Death and paid companion replacement
rules.requirement: All pets and survivors have HP and can die. Zero HP tombstones that live instance, stops contact/work, releases transient claims and creates one persistent typed estate for its remaining cargo. Replacement requires a complete ordinary earnable resource/cash bill and creates a new instance once. Preserve earned companion level/XP/skills, account unlocks and permanent paid entitlements; the user specified equipment-level loss, not companion-level loss. The replacement starts with full earned max HP and empty cargo, and the old estate is claimed separately. No free care revival, automatic respawn, mandatory repeated real-money purchase or resurrection by save/roster reset.

rules.title: Progression and environment continuity
rules.requirement: Every species retains a real usable attack throughout applicable progression; this does not require each animal to fight in every region or terrain cell. Region owners bind safe deployment, reachable attacks, local target compatibility, transport, return and cargo continuity. An unsuitable environment may have an explicit inapplicable combat disposition with a useful safe alternative assignment and a retained combat role elsewhere in the progression. Use already selected compatible routes/staging or appropriate equipment only where it fits the region; do not invent new facilities/gear merely to fill a matrix, ordinary owl underwater flight, quadruped free flight or invisible remote damage. No silent conversion of a species to support-only and no mandatory paid environmental competence.

rules.title: Actual evidence, current standard
rules.requirement: Bind every species to its preserved selected GitHub sheet and actual mesh/rig/profile/scene. Prove positive-damage attacks, miss, interruption, target loss, recall, return-to-specialty, hurt/death, paid replacement presentation and a later suitable-region scenario with exact-source full-cycle multi-angle playback and actual sound listening. Human hunting/work, destruction/breach, repair/rebuild and blackout/restoration also need complete actual use states. Native rule tests prove only their declared logic. Retain each reference dimension at least9.9 and stronger exact10 final visual gates; historical or standalone passes cannot close gameplay tasks.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Close escort and recovery of eligible light cargo.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Agile ground scouting and suitable light retrieval.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Dart into a legitimate opening, pounce/bite for meaningful damage and disengage. Demonstrate the attack during ordinary play; a fox that only fetches, warns or evades fails.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Aerial reconnaissance, warning and suitable light retrieval.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Take off, bank/anticipate, dive and strike with actual talon contact, recover in clear air and return/perch. A circling bird with a damage timer or a warning-only owl fails.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Defense of an exposed approach and protection of working allies.

Use a reachable approach for a low ambush/pounce/claw/bite; no teleport flank. Show distinct timing/posture from the lion and return to its assigned objective.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Approved heavy hauling/obstacle work plus protection.

lifecycle_contract.rule: HP0 creates a death receipt, cancels work/attack and transfers current cargo to estate once. Full ordinary payment creates new instance; old instance stays dead. Earned level/XP/skills and entitlements survive, cargo is not copied.

Finite authored HP; material bill follows asset/tier/missingHP. Reconstructed fence/gate retains purchased tier and takes a new physical generation. Its remaining paid HP budget cannot erase subsequent damage.
Partial repair retains tier. AtHP0, contents become typed salvage, old-generation jobs/quotes stop and a new paid plot rebuild creates level1. Prior equipment upgrades must be bought again.

Affects one camp: pause automated production, new customer admission and ordinary non-recovery worker jobs. Keep manual gathering, recovery jobs, salvage/cash collection, combat, repair/rebuild, companion replacement and travel available. No player-level reset, stock wipe, compulsory wait or premium recovery.

Quote has fixed HP budget and generation. Funded materials enter escrow; applying actual HP consumes cumulative proportional effort. Cancel/refuse only unused escrow. New damage does not enlarge a funded budget; target-generation loss refunds remaining escrow safely, including to a deceased payer estate.

Budget, pending attack identities and outcome persist. Walking/render unloading does not remove logical enemies or restore HP. Core defeat admits no new strikes; resolves committed contacts then retreats. No victory/clear reward for loss, retreat or unload. Physical retreat/navigation remains scene work.

No spawned server or invulnerable customer. Threats route visitors away; unrestricted siege permits real damage. Before sale, cancellation releases reserved basket to stock/salvage; after sale, cash remains earned and customer goods do not become resale loot. Visitor physical HP/evacuation and motion require actual scene integration.
